agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has single fast body (speed ~41-42 m/s) with near-elastic restitution e=0.998 bouncing off ceiling. Energy is stable ~988 J for steps 50-62 (below 10%+5 J limit ~1000.3 J) but jumps to ~1003 J at step 63 after ceiling bounce, exceeding the limit despite e<1 should dissipate energy. Controller off, gravity 9.81, 5 substeps. Likely cause is collision response: impulse with high restitution plus positional correction for penetration adds spurious mechanical energy at high-speed impacts, exceeding the energy_bound tolerance. Lowering restitution removes the gain.
